title: [E12-14] Private Local Weekly Device Summary
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E12-14 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/13

**User Story:**
As a wearable participant, I want a private weekly local summary, so I can review device behavior without uploading monitoring history.

**Epic:** E12 — Optional wearable safety, firmware & privacy  
**Domain:** IoT firmware / Local companion / Privacy  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Firmware/Privacy  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-033, US-041  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E12`, `iot-firmware`, `local-companion`, `privacy`

**Dependencies:** [E12-13](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/163)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: E12-13; additional proposed blockers: None.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Device or local companion displays allowed totals and time window; deleting local data works; production API receives no summary.
- [ ] Aggregate permitted activity/reminder totals over a defined local weekly window.
- [ ] Show units, data coverage, simulator/device provenance and missing intervals.
- [ ] Keep summary exclusively on device or participant-local companion with bounded retention.
- [ ] Delete local summaries on request and make no commerce upload or admin retrieval available.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use LocalWeeklySummary derived from local events; calendar boundaries/timezone and clock-change behavior are documented.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Run a trace crossing a week boundary, verify totals and delete them; inspect storage/traffic for no server copy.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
